sql: WITH o AS ( SELECT o.kalshi_order_id, o.strategy, o.created_at, o.status, o.limit_price, o.quantity FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy IN ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') AND o.kalshi_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.created_at >= now() - interval '336 hours' AND o.status IN ('filled','canceled') ), cp AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[15,30,45,60,90,120,150,180,210]) AS age_min), tk AS ( SELECT t.kalshi_order_id, t.captured_at, t.contracts_ahead, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.captured_at - o.created_at))/60.0 AS age FROM live_order_queue_ticks t JOIN o ON o.kalshi_order_id = t.kalshi_order_id WHERE t.queue_position IS NOT NULL ), at_cp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.kalshi_order_id, cp.age_min) o.kalshi_order_id, cp.age_min, o.status, o.strategy, tk.contracts_ahead AS ahead_now, tk.age FROM o CROSS JOIN cp JOIN tk ON tk.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id WHERE tk.age BETWEEN cp.age_min - 3 AND cp.age_min + 3 ORDER BY o.kalshi_order_id, cp.age_min, abs(tk.age - cp.age_min) ) SELECT age_min, CASE WHEN ahead_now=0 THEN 'b0' WHEN ahead_now<=10 THEN 'b1_10' WHEN ahead_now<=100 THEN 'b11_100' WHEN ahead_now<=1000 THEN 'b101_1k' WHEN ahead_now<=5000 THEN 'b1k_5k' ELSE 'b5k+' END AS bucket_now, count(*) AS still_resting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled') AS filled_later, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled')/count(*),1) AS pct_fill_later FROM at_cp GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
